details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, K6, and K7 are all PRESENT with supporting evidence in the candidate summary. K5 is MISSING as there is no mention of product milestones such as Control Testing module launch, AI-augmented engineering adoption, or Entity Management development plans. K8 is MISSING as there is no reference to partner network expansion in the DACH region or the contribution of the partner channel to new ARR. While the summary covers most high-importance financial and operational metrics, the absence of K5 and K8—particularly the product roadmap details in K5—prevents a full 'Yes' rating. The overall coverage is strong but not complete.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected and support each other without contradictions. The narrative flows from revenue growth through profitability metrics to capital position and future outlook. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, organizational issues, or unnecessary repetition. The financial metrics are presented consistently and support the overall narrative of improved performance and strategic positioning.
